title: Improving LLM Code Reasoning via Semantic Equivalence Self-Play with Formal Verification
authors_zh: Poon Tsz Nok、Antonio Valerio Miceli Barone
best_for_zh: 关注代码推理数据、混合验证器、自博弈课程与发布审计的研究者
one_line: Releases 28,253 runnable Haskell references and specifies proof/counterexample self-play, but not the central verified interaction corpus or adapters.
公开 28,253 条可运行 Haskell 参考程序，并给出形式证明/执行反例自博弈方案，但未发布核心验证交互语料与适配器。
why: Shows how formal positive evidence and executable negative witnesses can be combined in a data curriculum, while making the verification-yield and reproducibility trade-offs measurable.
inclusion_reason: Provides an auditable mixed-verifier recipe for executable Haskell references and proof/counterexample self-play, while exposing important release and lineage gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Program-reasoning data often treats compilation or a finite test suite as a proxy for semantics. Neither is sufficient for teaching whether two programs agree on all inputs: compilation checks well-formedness, while passing selected tests can miss rare behavioral differences. Fully proving equivalence is also undecidable in general, so any dataset must state the fragment and oracle it actually covers.

The paper targets this gap in pure Haskell. Its data problem has two layers that must not be conflated: first, build a pool of runnable Haskell reference programs from Python-oriented instruction data; second, derive pairs in which a generator either proves equivalence or exhibits inequivalence. The public release covers the first layer. The second, which contains the proof/counterexample interactions used for agent training, is described and evaluated but not released as a standalone corpus.

代码推理数据常把“能够编译”或“通过有限测试”当作语义正确的替代信号，但两者都不足以教会模型判断两个程序是否在所有输入上行为一致：编译只检查程序是否良构，有限测试则可能漏掉罕见差异。另一方面，程序等价性在一般情形下不可判定，因此数据集必须明确它实际覆盖的程序片段与判定器边界。

本文在纯函数式 Haskell 中处理这一缺口。其数据问题包含两个不可混淆的层次：先把面向 Python 的指令数据转化为可运行的 Haskell 参考程序池，再由生成器构造程序对，并为等价提供证明、为不等价提供反例。公开发布只覆盖第一层；第二层包含实际用于智能体训练的证明/反例交互，论文虽给出方法和实验，但没有将其作为独立语料发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Each episode starts from a reference program \(P\). With nominal 50/50 probability, Alice enters one of two games. In SEQ, she proposes a differently implemented \(Q\) and a Liquid Haskell lemma intended to establish \(P(x)=Q(x)\) for every supported input. In SINQ, she proposes \(Q\) and one input \(x_a\) for which execution should show \(P(x_a)\ne Q(x_a)\). Failed proofs or failed divergence checks are rejected before model judgment.

Bob sees only \(P\) and \(Q\), not Alice's witness, and classifies them as equivalent or inequivalent. Ten sampled judgments estimate hardness as \(10(1-N_{correct}/10)\). This separates two contracts: a machine checker determines whether Alice supplied admissible semantic evidence, while Bob's errors provide a curriculum signal rather than ground truth. The asymmetry is deliberate: positive examples require proof within Liquid Haskell's supported fragment; negative examples need only one executable counterexample.

每个回合从参考程序 \(P\) 开始。Alice 按名义上的 50/50 概率进入两类博弈之一：在 SEQ 中，她生成实现方式不同的 \(Q\)，并给出 Liquid Haskell 引理，试图在工具支持的输入范围内证明对所有 \(x\) 都有 \(P(x)=Q(x)\)；在 SINQ 中，她生成 \(Q\) 和一个输入 \(x_a\)，要求执行结果满足 \(P(x_a)\ne Q(x_a)\)。证明失败或未观察到差异的样本会在模型判断之前被拒绝。

Bob 只看到 \(P\) 与 \(Q\)，看不到 Alice 的证据，并判断二者是否等价。系统重复采样十次，以 \(10(1-N_{correct}/10)\) 估计难度。这里有两个明确分开的契约：机器检查器判定 Alice 的语义证据能否接受，Bob 的错误率只用于课程信号而不是事实标签。正负样本采用非对称验证：正例必须在 Liquid Haskell 支持的片段内给出形式证明，负例只需一个可执行反例。

title: Method
方法
html:
OpInstruct-HSx is constructed by taking prefiltered OpenCodeInstruct self-instruct rows and asking DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B to produce Haskell. The released construction code deduplicates generated code strings, searches for a function binding and an arrow type, recursively synthesizes a type-compatible literal for common base/list/tuple types, then invokes GHC and executes the program on that input. Retained rows expose five fields: code, input, status, output, and size. This establishes minimal executability on one synthesized input; it does not compare the Haskell program with the upstream Python solution.

For self-play, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is used for both Alice and Bob. SEQ adds reflection annotations and a generated lemma to a Liquid Haskell module using PLE; acceptance by Liquid Haskell retains the proof trace. SINQ compiles and runs both programs under a subprocess harness on Alice's proposed input; differing outputs, exceptions, or termination behavior are intended as inequivalence witnesses. Bob is sampled ten times after branch verification. Alice training comprises selected raw generations, difficulty-prediction examples, and all accepted SEQ proof traces; Bob training retains correct equivalence judgments.

The main E0 configuration uses 500 references per round, seven rounds, a nominal 50/50 branch probability, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, presence penalty 1.5, and a 32,768-token context. Rejection-sampling LoRA SFT uses cumulative retained data. Generation in round \(i+1\) uses Alice's adapter from round \(i\), but each fine-tune is initialized from the original base model; Bob is fine-tuned once after all seven rounds. The paper reports about three days on four NVIDIA L40S GPUs.

OpInstruct-HSx 的构造从预筛选的 OpenCodeInstruct self-instruct 样本开始，由 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 生成 Haskell。公开代码先对生成代码字符串做精确去重，再查找函数绑定和含箭头的类型签名，针对常见基础类型、列表与元组递归合成类型兼容的字面量，最后调用 GHC 编译并在该输入上执行。保留样本公开五个字段：code、input、status、output 和 size。这一流程只能说明程序在一个合成输入上最低限度可运行，并未把 Haskell 结果与上游 Python 解答做语义比较。

自博弈的 Alice 与 Bob 都使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B。SEQ 把反射标注和生成引理写入启用 PLE 的 Liquid Haskell 模块，工具接受后保留证明轨迹；SINQ 则通过子进程执行框架，在 Alice 给出的输入上编译并运行两个程序，以输出、异常或终止行为的差异作为不等价证据。通过分支验证后，系统对 Bob 重复采样十次。Alice 的训练数据包括筛选后的原始生成、难度预测样本以及所有通过验证的 SEQ 证明轨迹；Bob 的训练数据保留其判断正确的等价性回答。

主实验 E0 每轮使用 500 个参考程序，共七轮，名义分支比例为 50/50；采样参数为温度 0.6、top-p 0.95、top-k 20、presence penalty 1.5，上下文长度 32,768。拒绝采样 LoRA SFT 使用累计保留数据：第 \(i+1\) 轮生成使用第 \(i\) 轮的 Alice 适配器，但每轮微调都从原始基础模型初始化；Bob 只在七轮结束后微调一次。论文报告主实验约需四张 NVIDIA L40S 运行三天。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The public dataset revision checked by the card contains 28,253 rows and five columns: 25,427 train and 2,826 test. The paper reports a seed-42 90/10 split and no exact-code overlap between splits. These counts verify the released runnable-reference object, not the size of the self-play corpus. The release omits upstream row IDs and the original instruction/Python solution, so semantic duplicates and source-level leakage cannot be audited from the rows alone.

Verifier yield is the central construction result. Across the main run's 1,750 nominal attempts per branch, only 34 SEQ examples passed Liquid Haskell (1.94%), while 903 SINQ examples passed the divergence check (51.6%). Thus the mixed E0 training pool has 937 verified pairs and is overwhelmingly negative despite balanced attempts. A pure-SINQ E1 run yields 1,839 pairs; the SEQ-heavy E2 run yields 62 SEQ plus 78 SINQ pairs; the volume-matched pure-SINQ E3 yields 156 pairs.

The reported downstream results support a training-effect hypothesis but do not by themselves establish dataset quality. For example, Bob improves from 50.2% to 57.4% accuracy on EquiBench OJ_A and from 56.5% to 69.8% on OJ_V; PySecDB accuracy rises from 67.6% to 68.8%. Transfer is weak or mixed on low-level categories and CodeXGLUE. In controlled comparisons, E0 beats higher-volume E1 on several structural equivalence settings, while E2/E3 are small (140/156 verified pairs), so the paper's claim that SEQ contributes distinctive reasoning evidence is suggestive and ablation-backed, not a general proof of data quality.

本卡核验的公开数据版本共有 28,253 行、五列，其中训练集 25,427 行，测试集 2,826 行。论文说明按随机种子 42 做 90/10 划分，并报告两个划分间没有完全相同的代码。这些数字验证的是公开的可运行参考程序对象，不代表自博弈语料规模。由于样本没有上游行标识、原始指令和 Python 解答，仅凭公开行无法审计语义重复或源问题泄漏。

验证器产出率是最关键的构造证据。主实验两个分支各名义尝试 1,750 次，SEQ 只有 34 条通过 Liquid Haskell（1.94%），SINQ 则有 903 条通过差异执行检查（51.6%）。因此，虽然尝试比例均衡，E0 最终 937 条验证程序对仍严重偏向负例。纯 SINQ 的 E1 得到 1,839 对；SEQ 占优的 E2 得到 62 条 SEQ 和 78 条 SINQ；按规模匹配的纯 SINQ E3 得到 156 对。

下游结果支持“训练产生了作用”的假设，但不能单独证明数据质量。例如，Bob 在 EquiBench OJ_A 上的准确率由 50.2% 升至 57.4%，在 OJ_V 上由 56.5% 升至 69.8%；PySecDB 准确率由 67.6% 升至 68.8%。低层类别与 CodeXGLUE 上的迁移较弱或呈混合结果。受控比较中，E0 在若干结构等价任务上优于数据量更大的 E1，但 E2/E3 只有 140/156 个验证程序对，因此“SEQ 提供独特推理信号”的结论有消融支持且值得重视，却不是数据质量的一般性证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The recipe's useful novelty is not self-play alone. It couples two semantically meaningful but asymmetric machine contracts inside one curriculum: formal proof for positive equivalence and concrete execution for negative inequivalence. This avoids asking a learned judge to invent the label, while still using the judge's repeated error rate to rank difficulty.

It also makes proof scarcity observable rather than hiding it behind aggregate benchmark scores. The SEQ/SINQ yield gap exposes a practical trade-off between high-fidelity positive supervision and scalable negative supervision. The three-part Alice dataset—challenging transformations, self-predicted difficulty, and verified proof traces—connects data construction to agent behavior at generation, calibration, and proof steps.

Relative to the prior SINQ game, the added SEQ branch changes both the data object and verifier: an accepted positive pair carries a machine-checkable proof rather than merely a class label. OpInstruct-HSx supplies a runnable Haskell substrate, but the paper's substantive contribution is the mixed-verifier interaction recipe built on top of it.

这套方案的实质新意并不只是“自博弈”，而是在同一课程中组合两种具有语义意义但不对称的机器契约：正向等价必须提供形式证明，负向不等价必须提供具体执行反例。这样，事实标签无需由学习型判别器创造，而判别器的重复错误率仍可用于难度排序。

方案还把证明稀缺性直接暴露出来，而不是用汇总基准分数遮蔽。SEQ/SINQ 的巨大产出率差距清楚呈现了高保真正向监督与可扩展负向监督之间的现实权衡。Alice 的三类数据——困难程序变换、自身难度预测和已验证证明轨迹——分别连接生成、校准与证明步骤。

相较先前的 SINQ 博弈，新增 SEQ 分支同时改变了数据对象和验证器：一个通过接受的正例程序对携带机器可检查证明，而不只是类别标签。OpInstruct-HSx 提供可运行的 Haskell 基底，但论文更核心的贡献是建立在其上的混合验证器交互构造方案。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public release is incomplete for reproducing the central training data. OpInstruct-HSx is available, as are pipeline and evaluation files, but the checked repository does not publish the verified per-round SEQ/SINQ records or trained adapters as a clean release. Consequently, one can inspect the recipe and many result artifacts but cannot independently reconstruct the exact retained training mixture without rerunning the expensive pipeline.

Lineage is weak at the released-row level. The five fields omit the OpenCodeInstruct identifier, original instruction, Python solution, translator prompt/output, model revision, and rejection path. A single successful generated input proves only that the translated Haskell program ran once. It does not prove translation fidelity, broad functional correctness, or equivalence to the upstream program. Exact-code split deduplication does not address paraphrased or semantically equivalent leakage.

Liquid Haskell covers a restricted fragment. Reflection and PLE do not readily handle nontermination, partial functions, unreflectable code, large algebraic rewrites, state, memory, or bit-level behavior. This restricts both what can be labeled positive and what learned behavior should be expected to transfer. The main run's 34/1,750 SEQ yield makes the resulting class and verifier mixture highly imbalanced.

Reproducibility details conflict across official artifacts: the paper states a main threshold of 3, the inspected example run script passes 1, and the CLI default is 5. Moreover, SEQ.py appends generation examples to the candidate pool only when difficulty already meets the threshold, then later divides that pool into hard and easy subsets; the easy generation subset is therefore empty in that path, making the advertised 20%-easy sampling unreachable. Package versions and an immutable environment are also not fully specified. These issues warrant partial status and must not be silently resolved by guessing.

公开发布不足以复现核心训练数据。OpInstruct-HSx、流水线代码和大量评测文件可以访问，但本卡检查的仓库没有把逐轮验证后的 SEQ/SINQ 记录或训练适配器整理为正式发布物。因此，读者可以审查方案和许多结果文件，却无法在不重新运行高成本流程的情况下独立还原实际保留的训练混合。

公开行级谱系较弱。五个字段没有保留 OpenCodeInstruct 标识、原始指令、Python 解答、翻译提示与输出、模型修订以及拒绝路径。在一个生成输入上成功执行，只能证明翻译后的 Haskell 程序运行过一次，不能证明翻译忠实、广泛功能正确或与上游程序语义等价。按代码字符串精确去重也无法处理改写或语义等价泄漏。

Liquid Haskell 只覆盖受限程序片段。反射与 PLE 难以处理不终止、偏函数、不可反射代码、大规模代数改写、状态、内存和位级行为。因此，正例标注范围和可期待的迁移范围都受到限制。主实验 SEQ 只有 34/1,750 的通过率，使最终类别与验证器混合严重失衡。

官方材料之间还存在复现冲突：论文说明主实验难度阈值为 3，检查到的示例运行脚本传入 1，而命令行默认值为 5。此外，SEQ.py 只有在生成样本难度已经达到阈值时才把它加入候选池，之后又从该候选池划分困难与简单样本；因此该路径中的简单生成子集必然为空，所描述的 20% 简单样本抽样实际上不可达。依赖版本和不可变环境也未完整给出。这些未知和冲突必须保留，不能靠猜测补齐，因此状态应为 partial。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction → Open Release Recipes track, this paper is useful as a mixed-verifier case study rather than as a complete ready-to-train dataset release. It identifies the reference object, generation agents, acceptance oracles, difficulty estimator, sampling rule, optimizer scaffold, compute budget, and branch-level yield. Those details make it possible to compare formal-positive and executable-negative construction costs.

Concrete uses include designing proof/counterexample curricula for code models; separating label verification from learned difficulty scoring; estimating how proof yield constrains class balance before scaling; and auditing whether a public reference pool actually includes the downstream interaction traces. The released 28,253-row pool can support Haskell compilation/execution experiments, but users should not describe it as the paper's SEQ/SINQ training corpus.

The paper is also a useful negative template for release planning: retain upstream IDs and prompts, version the teacher and verifier environment, publish per-stage rejection counts, release verified episodes and split manifests, and pin the exact launch configuration. Its threshold mismatch and unreachable easy-sampling path illustrate why paper prose, scripts, and released rows must be audited together.

对于 数据构造 → 开放发布方案 轨道，本文更适合作为混合验证器案例，而不是可直接训练的完整数据发布。它明确了参考对象、生成智能体、接受判定器、难度估计器、抽样规则、优化脚手架、计算预算和分支级产出率，因此可以据此比较形式正例与可执行负例的构造成本。

具体用途包括：为代码模型设计证明/反例课程；把标签验证与学习型难度评分分离；在扩展规模之前估计证明产出率对类别平衡的约束；审计公开参考程序池是否真的包含后续交互轨迹。公开的 28,253 条程序可用于 Haskell 编译与执行实验，但不应被描述为论文的 SEQ/SINQ 训练语料。

本文也可作为发布规划的反面模板：应保留上游 ID 与提示，固定教师模型和验证器环境版本，公开各阶段拒绝计数，发布已验证回合与划分清单，并锁定实际启动配置。阈值冲突和不可达的简单样本抽样路径说明，论文叙述、运行脚本与公开数据必须联合审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read “validated Haskell programs” narrowly: rows passed a syntax/type-oriented extraction plus one compile/run check. Validation is not a proof of translation equivalence.
  • Keep the two feedback sources distinct. Liquid Haskell or execution accepts Alice's witness; Bob's ten responses measure difficulty. Bob is not the ground-truth verifier.
  • The released data object is code/input/status/output/size. Proofs, counterexamples, Bob responses, and curriculum decisions belong to the described but unreleased interaction object.
  • The main result is partly a yield study: positive proof data are much scarcer than negative counterexamples. Benchmark improvements should be interpreted alongside the 34-versus-903 accepted-count asymmetry.
  • The E2/E3 comparison controls approximate verified-pair volume, but accepted difficulty distributions and Bob-update class balance may still differ, as the appendix acknowledges.
  • Official artifact revisions checked for this card are GitHub 490fe084d705cb501e0fe34e592f17db2eb44a7b and Hugging Face 57f52ef2f46d24f3b6155648e9a895e544b2455d. Still unknown: exact upstream row mapping, semantic decontamination, exact translator revision, complete dependency lock, verified episode release, and adapter release.

• “已验证 Haskell 程序”应作窄义理解：样本通过了面向语法/类型的抽取和一次编译执行检查，并不意味着已经证明翻译语义等价。
  • 必须区分两类反馈。Liquid Haskell 或执行结果负责接受 Alice 的证据；Bob 的十次回答只估计难度，Bob 不是事实验证器。
  • 公开数据对象只有 code/input/status/output/size。证明、反例、Bob 回答与课程决策属于论文描述但未发布的交互对象。
  • 论文的关键结果也可视为产出率研究：正向证明数据远比负向反例稀缺。解读基准提升时必须同时看到 34 条与 903 条接受样本的非对称性。
  • E2/E3 比较近似控制了验证程序对数量，但附录也承认，接受样本的难度分布以及 Bob 更新时的类别平衡仍可能不同。
  • 本卡检查的官方发布修订为 GitHub 490fe084d705cb501e0fe34e592f17db2eb44a7b 与 Hugging Face 57f52ef2f46d24f3b6155648e9a895e544b2455d。以下信息仍为 unknown：上游行级映射、语义去污染、翻译模型精确修订、完整依赖锁、验证回合发布以及适配器发布。
